subject.title: [RFC] Multi-Session Architecture: Shared LLM + Isolated Sessions + Public Knowledge Base

question: Should this RFC remain the umbrella for multi-session architecture, or should maintainers split it in favor of focused trackers for topic families, channel grouping, Google Chat Space delivery, and session UI lifecycle?
rationale: Current main covers some lifecycle and routing primitives, while the remaining work changes session architecture, storage, routing, UI, memory/privacy boundaries, and migration policy; automation cannot choose that product/security decomposition.

options.title: Keep as umbrella RFC
options.body: Keep this issue open as the architecture umbrella and link focused implementation trackers under it.

options.title: Split and close umbrella
options.body: Move the remaining work into focused issues such as session families, channel groups, Google Chat Spaces, and session UI, then close this RFC as superseded.

options.title: Narrow to one phase
options.body: Edit or replace the request with one maintainer-approved phase, such as UI lifecycle or routing only, before implementation starts.

recommendation.title: Keep as umbrella RFC
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the architecture umbrella and link focused implementation trackers under it.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent central session/routing and Control UI session commits make this the best available routing owner for the product-direction call.
